title: Book Seaglass Cottage & Carriage House | Rosemary Beach Vacation Cottage Rental – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Discover the elegance of Seaglass Cottage & Carriage House in Rosemary Beach. This stunning rental offers spacious living, beachside charm, and accommodations for a memorable getaway.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Seaglass Cottage & Carriage House —a breathtaking coastal retreat where timeless elegance meets relaxed seaside charm. This 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom haven offers an exquisite blend of luxury and comfort, making it the perfect escape for families and groups seeking an unforgettable getaway.

Step inside the cottage, where refined interiors and thoughtful coastal touches create a serene and inviting atmosphere. The open-concept living area is both stylish and comfortable, offering ample seating for gatherings. A spacious dining area with a large dining table provides the perfect setting for shared meals and lively conversation. French doors open to a picturesque courtyard, where you'll find a private pool, a summer kitchen, outdoor dining, and an expansive entertaining space, all designed for the ultimate in relaxation and enjoyment.

The first-floor king master suite is a private oasis, featuring an en-suite bath with a walk-in shower and a luxurious soaking tub. Across the hall is an additional den, perfect for a home office or nap time for any little ones.

On the second floor, three beautifully appointed king bedrooms each boast an en-suite bathroom, ensuring comfort and privacy for guests. This floor also features an additional living space, perfect for quiet moments or casual lounging. A fourth bedroom with two twin singles shares a full bath with the living area, making it an ideal setup for families.

The third floor offers a fun and spacious retreat, with a bunk room featuring six twin beds and plenty of room to relax and play—perfect for younger guests or large groups.

For those seeking a bit more seclusion, the carriage house provides private living quarters with a king bed and a charming balcony, offering a peaceful escape while still being connected to the main home.

From the carefully curated interiors to the inviting outdoor spaces, Seaglass Cottage & Carriage House embodies laid-back luxury with sophisticated coastal charm. Whether you’re unwinding by the pool, gathering around the table, or strolling to the nearby beach, this exceptional home promises an unforgettable stay.
